newsitem.title: GERMANY: German unemployment seen at 4.67 million in Feb.
newsitem.headline: German unemployment seen at 4.67 million in Feb.

text.p: German unemployment climbed 13,000 to a record 4.671 million in February, German television reported on Tuesday.
ZDF television did not give a source for the figure, but said it was already "in the financial markets." The February figures will be officially released by the Federal Labour Office on Thursday.
In January the jobless total surged by more than 500,000 to 4.66 million, the highest level since Adolf Hitler's rise to power in the 1930s.
German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Monday he expected unemployment to show only a slight rise in February.

The unabated rise in unemployment with the resulting benefit payouts and loss of tax revenues has sparked fears that Germany may not be able to get its finances in shape for European monetary union, due to start on January 1, 1999.
